Lessons & Knowledge

What went well, what to improve, and reusable knowledge.

What went well

Early process standardization

Finalizing 100% of the framework docs up front let development teams work in parallel without overlap.

To improve

Internal communication

Information gaps early on caused a 2-week slip; a standardized weekly reporting cadence is needed.

Reusable knowledge

Reusable barcode integration pattern

The device-connector adapter can be reused for future warehouse projects.
